summary: NAFIS urges the FCC to consider the unique circumstances of federally impacted school districts when evaluating changes to E-Rate eligibility, discounts, infrastructure support, and administration. Preserves broad E-Rate eligibility based on geographic classifications and provider competition, not solely on rural status or the number of broadband providers serving a community. The comments from NAFIS urge the FCC to modernize E-Rate while preserving access for federally impacted districts, emphasizing the importance of the program for ensuring access to reliable connectivity for students and educators. They oppose unnecessary restrictions and administrative burdens on the program.
filer_raw: The National Association of Federally Impacted Schools (NAFIS)
